```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Loading packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
```

Creating dataframe
```{r}
killi <- read_csv("../Data/VOX_Killifish.csv",
                  locale = locale(encoding = "Windows-1252")) #this is because of the special characters in excel

str(killi)
```

cleaning names
```{r}
killi <- killi %>%
  clean_names()
```

converting predictors to factors
```{r}
killi <- killi %>%
  mutate(across(c(acclimation_temperature_c,
                  acclimation_salinity_ppt,
                  test_temperature_c),
                as.factor))
```

```{r}
responses <- c(
  "resting_metabolic_rate_mmol_o_g_min",
  "maximal_metabolic_rate_mmol_o_g_min",
  "aerobic_scope_mmol_o_g_min",
  "maximal_cox_activity_mmol_mg_protein_min",
  "maximal_cs_activity_mmol_mg_protein_min",
  "maximal_ldh_activity_mmol_mg_protein_min"
)
```

```{r}
models <- map(responses, ~ {

  df <- killi %>%
    select(
      all_of(.x),
      acclimation_temperature_c,
      acclimation_salinity_ppt,
      test_temperature_c,
      fish_id_number
    ) %>%
    na.omit()

  lmer(
    as.formula(paste0(
      .x,
      " ~ acclimation_temperature_c * acclimation_salinity_ppt + 
          acclimation_temperature_c * test_temperature_c +  
          acclimation_salinity_ppt * test_temperature_c +
         (1 | fish_id_number)"
    )),
    data = df
  )
})

names(models) <- responses
```

Results table
```{r}
library(broom.mixed)

results <- purrr::map_df(names(models), ~ {
  broom.mixed::tidy(models[[.x]])
}, .id = "response")
results <- purrr::map_df(names(models), function(x) {
  broom.mixed::tidy(models[[x]]) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(response = x)
})
```

builds one plot per response
```{r}
make_plot <- function(response_name, models, data) {

  model <- models[[response_name]]

  # pick predictor to test (example: acclimation temperature)
  emmeans(model, ~ acclimation_temperature_c, type = "response")

  # pairwise comparisons for significance
  contrasts <- as.data.frame(pairs(emm))

  # convert p-values to stars
  contrasts <- contrasts %>%
    mutate(stars = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ))

  # base boxplot
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(
    x = acclimation_temperature_c,
    y = .data[[response_name]]
  )) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = response_name, x = "Acclimation Temperature")

  # add simple global significance (if any significant effect exists)
  if (any(contrasts$p.value < 0.05)) {
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text",
      x = 1.5,
      y = max(data[[response_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
      label = "*",
      size = 6
    )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

loops for all responses
```{r}
plots <- map(responses, ~ make_plot(.x, models, killi))
names(plots) <- responses
```

```{r}
cox_activity <- ggplot(
  killi,
  aes(
    x = Acclimation_Temperature,
    y = COX_Activity,
    fill = Assay_Temperature
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      dodge.width = 0.8,
      jitter.width = 0.2
    ),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2,
    shape = 21  
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "10" = "#6BAED6",
      "24" = "#FB6A4A"
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic()+
  labs(
    x = "Acclimation Temperature",
    y = "COX Activity",
    fill="Assay Temperature"
  ) +
   theme(
     panel.grid = element_blank(),                        
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12), # axis labels bigger & bold
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12), # facet labels bigger & bold
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12))#
  
plot(cox_activity)
```

```{r}
ggsave(

)
```
